item.title: Bills outlast Rams in overtime thriller
item.description: Tyler Bass kicked a 45-yard field goal with 1:55 left in overtime as Buffalo edged Los Angeles 37-34. Josh Allen threw for 210 yards and ran for 121 more, while James Cook added 111 rushing yards and two touchdowns. The Rams forced overtime despite Buffalo leading 31-20 in the fourth quarter.

item.title: Brewers seize 2-0 NLCS lead over Dodgers
item.description: In a major follow-up to Milwaukee’s Game 1 win, William Contreras homered to tie Game 2, drove in the go-ahead run an inning later and finished with three hits and three RBIs in a 7-4 victory. Four Brewers relievers retired all 15 batters they faced, sending the NLCS to Los Angeles with Milwaukee ahead 2-0.

item.title: Guardians break late for ALCS Game 1 win
item.description: Cleveland scored seven runs over the final four innings to beat Tampa Bay 7-3 in the ALCS opener. Nathaniel Lowe’s two-run single in the eighth broke a 2-2 tie, and José Ramírez drove in a run for the fourth straight postseason game. The Guardians finished with 14 hits.

item.title: Jaguars stun Eagles with 57-yard field goal in London
item.description: Cam Little hit a 57-yard field goal as time expired to give Jacksonville a 19-17 win over Philadelphia. Ameer Abdullah set it up with a 53-yard kickoff return after the Eagles had taken the lead with eight seconds left. Trevor Lawrence threw for 331 yards and two touchdowns as the Jaguars improved to 4-1.

item.title: Brewers edge Dodgers in NLCS opener
item.description: Brice Turang homered and Milwaukee's bullpen worked 4 2/3 scoreless innings in a 2-1 victory over the defending champion Dodgers. Rookie Luis Lara drove in the winning run, and Trevor Megill escaped two ninth-inning walks. The Brewers lead the National League Championship Series 1-0.

item.title: Huntley leads Ravens' overtime comeback
item.description: Backup quarterback Tyler Huntley threw a touchdown with 40 seconds left, Derrick Henry ran in the tying two-point conversion and Huntley scored on Baltimore's opening overtime drive. Kyle Hamilton then intercepted Tua Tagovailoa to seal a 30-23 victory over Atlanta.

item.title: Guardians finish ALDS comeback and advance
item.description: Cleveland completed its rally from a 2-0 series deficit by beating the White Sox 2-0 in Game 5. José Ramírez supplied a two-run homer, while Gavin Williams struck out 12 to tie a Guardians postseason record. Cleveland moves on to the American League Championship Series.

item.title: Oklahoma shocks No. 1 Texas on final-play field goal
item.description: Unranked Oklahoma stunned top-ranked Texas 27-24 when Tate Sandell kicked the winning field goal on the final play. The Sooners erased a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit, aided by two late Arch Manning interceptions, including a pick-six.

item.title: Marner's overtime winner keeps Golden Knights rolling
item.description: Mitch Marner scored on a 4-on-3 power play 2:40 into overtime as Vegas beat Los Angeles 2-1 for its fourth straight win. It was Marner's eighth career overtime goal and first with the Golden Knights, who moved back atop the Pacific Division.

item.title: Shesterkin injured as Capitals cool off the Rangers
item.description: Boone Jenner broke a 1-1 tie and Washington beat New York 3-1, ending the Rangers’ four-game winning streak. The larger concern was Igor Shesterkin, who left in the second period with a lower-body injury after jamming his right skate into the post and needed help reaching the bench.

item.title: Jayden Daniels cleared to return for Washington
item.description: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels will start Sunday against the Giants after missing two games with a dislocated left elbow. The 1-3 Commanders get their franchise quarterback back for a pivotal NFC East matchup, though Daniels will play with a brace.

item.title: NFL asks Supreme Court to settle prediction-market oversight
item.description: The NFL backed New Jersey’s request for Supreme Court review of whether federal or state regulators control sports prediction markets. The league says current federal oversight lacks safeguards common in legal sports betting, including a 21-year-old minimum and bans on wagers vulnerable to manipulation.

item.title: Guardians force a decisive Game 5 against the White Sox
item.description: Cleveland erased another elimination threat with a 9-5 win in Chicago, powered by homers from José Ramírez and Patrick Bailey and a six-run sixth inning. The ALDS returns to Cleveland for Saturday’s Game 5, with the winner advancing to face Tampa Bay.

item.title: MLB proposes 154-game season and a revamped postseason
item.description: Major League Baseball proposed cutting the schedule from 162 to 154 games in 2029, expanding the Division Series to seven games and letting higher seeds choose playoff opponents starting in 2027. The players union said the package remains tied to MLB’s push for a salary cap.

item.title: Stankoven’s first hat trick powers Carolina’s rout
item.description: Logan Stankoven recorded his first NHL hat trick and Andrei Svechnikov scored twice on the power play as Carolina overwhelmed Vancouver 7-2. Sean Walker added four assists, another career first, as the Hurricanes won their third straight.
